svg.title: Aria Compute — technology stack and data flows
svg.desc: Five-stage architecture map of Aria Compute. Touchpoints: agentbuddy (Tauri v2 desktop), cockpit (Android Compose car HMI), ariatag (Slack, Mail and WeChat AI employee). Orchestration: agenthub (A2A hub, port 3500), ariamem (knowledge and memory platform, port 8010), mcpx (MCP gateway, port 8848) in front of any HTTP service. Agent runtime: aria-agent-cloud (port 3000, SSE), aria-agent-core (recall, model, memorize, sandbox), cockpit store (port 3400), memo (on-device SQLite FTS5). Inference and routing: aria-router (port 8899, semantic, agent and afm-d routers), gateway (Bifrost behind Caddy or Nginx, 443), and external LLM providers. Models and training: aria-engine (port 8011, AFM-D runtime, /v1/systemone), ollaya (port 11435, local decision daemon), model/AFM-D (PyTorch, RLCD), ariapin (TRL post-training, port 8001), mlflow (port 5000). A shared state substrate holds PostgreSQL plus pgvector, SQLite aria memo, Apache AGE and MLflow runs. Five flows cycle automatically every eight seconds: A2A task, decision via System One, memory and RAG, MCP tools and channels, and train / export / serve.

g.title: agentbuddy — Tauri v2 + Vue 3 desktop workbench, loopback proxy to agenthub
cockpit — Android Compose car HMI, six-screen pager, cloud SSE + store sync
ariatag — Slack, Mail and WeChat AI employee on PostgreSQL, pgvector and Apache AGE
agenthub — A2A hub on Go and PostgreSQL, port 3500, registry and task state machine
ariamem — knowledge and memory platform on Go and pgvector, port 8010
mcpx — MCP gateway, port 8848, publishes any HTTP service as MCP tools
HTTP services — any language or framework, reachable through the mcpx prefix allowlist
aria-agent-cloud — Rust axum service, port 3000, OpenAI beta Agents API with SSE, Postgres and pgvector context
aria-agent-core — recall, model, memorize agent loop with pluggable sandbox
cockpit store — Rust axum structured data and memory sync service, port 3400
memo — local-first long-term memory, SQLite FTS5 plus local embeddings, four relation views
aria-router — OpenAI-compatible inference gateway, port 8899, semantic, agent and afm-d routers
gateway — Bifrost AI gateway behind Caddy or Nginx, port 443 to 8080
LLM providers — external OpenAI-compatible upstream model vendors
aria-engine — Rust AFM-D runtime, port 8011, POST /v1/systemone, C ABI
ollaya — local decision model daemon, port 11435, ONNX Runtime and llama.cpp
model / AFM-D — ModernBERT decision model trained with RLCD, 1024 token state, 512 token option head
ariapin — TRL post-training service, port 8001, LoRA lifecycle and gguf, mlx, mnn, qnn export
mlflow — experiment tracking on harness-net, port 5000
